summary: Two Harbors Investment Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a second amendment to its merger agreement with CrossCountry Intermediate Holdco (CCM) and its merger sub. The per-share cash consideration increased from $11.30 to $12.00. The termination fee payable by Two Harbors to CCM rose from $50.0M to $51.0M. CCM obtained a $1.4B unsecured financing commitment with new financing cooperation covenants. Two Harbors' board unanimously approved the amendment and reaffirmed its recommendation. The transaction is structured as a cash merger. Watch for stockholder vote and regulatory clearance; the increased consideration improves the risk-arb spread.
